resources.string: On. Ad servers are blocked in your apps and browsers.
%1$s ad lookups blocked since it started
Ads that come from an app\'s own servers, like those in the YouTube app, can\'t be blocked this way.
Keep it on: open VPN settings
Optional. Tap the gear next to Local Ad Blocker and turn on Always-on VPN.
Private DNS is set to a specific provider, which can send lookups around this filter. To fix it, go to Settings, search for Private DNS and choose Automatic.
Runs only on this phone. Nothing is sent to us or anyone else. Android shows a VPN key icon, but no outside VPN server is used.
